description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is highly skilled and our environment is safe for all residents and staff. You will play a key role in educating staff, implementing best practices, and maintaining compliance with all health regulations.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the quality of care and staff competency within our facility. If you are a proactive RN with a passion for education and infection control, we encourage you to apply and become a part of our committed healthcare team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Strong understanding and experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
